title: ABOUT US
body: (**Note:** We are not affiliated with any church, denomination or religious organization. We are a small family doing what we can to make a difference by inspiring more harmony, peace and compassion among us all. The views and opinions in these writings are ours.)
1. "WHERE ARE THE TWINS FROM?"          Sally and Silvie were born in Costa Rica and were raised in Costa Rica, France, Brazil and later lived for a while in the U.S.
2. "HOW MANY LANGUAGES DO THE TWINS SPEAK?"          The girls speak Spanish, English, French, & Portuguese.
3. "ARE THE TWINS MISSIONARIES?"          Yes. No. Maybe... kind of. But not in the traditional sense. Think of them as modern "internet missionaries".
4. "WHEN WAS SPONSORS OF HOPE FOUNDED?"          SOH was founded in 2004.
5. "WHERE DO YOUR DEVOTIONAL WRITINGS COME FROM?"          We write our own material.

6. "I AM HAVING TROUBLE WITH MY SPOUSE (kids, job, neighbors etc). CAN YOU HELP?"          We do not offer individual counseling and advice. Nor can we accept personal chats, phone calls or video calls.
7. "WHERE DO YOU FILM THE VIDEOS?"          We produce our video PSAs in different places. Wherever we happen to be.
8. "WHERE CAN I SEE YOUR VIDEOS ON TELEVISION?"          Please ask your local TV station to contact us if they are not already airing them in your area.

9. "WHAT DO YOU THINK ABOUT BAPTISM? (ABORTION? GAYS? ETC?)"          We do not waste our time arguing religious doctrine. We believe Christians should stop telling people what God wants them to do. Only God knows our hearts and Christians need to stop sticking their noses in everyone else's business.

10. "I NOTICED THAT YOU NEVER WEIGH IN ON POLITICAL ISSUES."          Correct. We believe that Christians who get involved in politics are misguided. The Bible says we should "be subject to those that rule over us", and that we should pray for them! -- not fight against them, but rather be examples of Christ's love!

11. "I NOTICE YOU RARELY ASK FOR DONATIONS. WHY IS THAT?"          We prefer that people give voluntarily as the Lord leads them, motivated by love. If you are one of these you can donate [HERE](https://square.link/u/EiiLjFxx).
12. "DO YOU REALLY THINK THERE WILL BE A HAPPY ENDING?"          Yes! We TRULY believe that LOVE will reign in the end!
